title: Programiz: Happy Number Checker
description: A happy number is a number defined by the following process: Starting with any positive integer, replace the number by the sum of the squares of its digits, and repeat the process until the number equals 1, or it loops endlessly in a cycle which does not include 1. Return `True` if happy, `False` otherwise.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 2^31 - 1
• Time: O(log N) | Space: O(log N)
explanation: Cycle detection on square digit sums identifies happy numbers in O(log N) time.
